618-3991-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ghave.

Resolve the Phantom Train ability.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

178-3259-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

Cast Forsaken Miner by paying {B}.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Sage of the Falls triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
Resolve the Sage of the Falls trigger, causing you to loot.

Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Lyla triggers.

When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.

Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.

Repeat.

Cast Soul Collector by paying {2}{B}{B}.

Resolve the Marauding Raptor trigger, dealing 2 damage to Soul Collector.
Soul Collector dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness.
Soul Collector triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Whenever an opponent casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Moderation prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

Fain does not have summoning sickness.

1636-2646-3000-4170.description:

The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

Declare any Godo token as an attacker.
The Godo token triggers, untapping itself and all Samurai you control, and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

Scholar of the Lost Trove enters the battlefield, casting Helvault from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1295-2499-2503.description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Inverter of Truth trigger, exiling your library face down and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the second Inverter of Truth trigger, exiling your library face down.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Thassa's Oracle trigger, causing you to win the game.
